agyos_skill.instructions: The **engagement craft** skill — the words you say *back*. Content gets you seen; engagement is what turns reach into relationships, community, and business. And the data is blunt about its value: **replying to comments is the single highest-return activity on every platform.** Four truths shape everything: 1. **Replying wins.** Responding to comments lifts engagement everywhere (by ~20–42% depending on platform); the **first ~15–20 minutes** matter most. Posting and disappearing is the common, costly mistake. 2. **Comments/DMs > likes.** "Comments show effort; likes show reaction." Real conversation builds community and feeds reach (and even AI-search visibility). 3. **Commenting on others borrows their audience** — a genuinely valuable comment on a bigger niche account is a primary growth channel. 4. **Genuine only.** Engagement must be real human interaction; automated/fake comments are detected, blocked, and penalized. This skill **drafts**; the human **posts.** Every reply is the brand speaking — so this skill **reads `voice.md` + `brand-profile.md` first.** Load `brand-profile.md` and `voice.md`. Get the **comment/DM/post** to respond to (the user pastes/forwards it — WoopSocial can't pull it) and the **goal** (relationship, lead, community, care). Be present in the **golden hour**; draft **voice-consistent** replies matched to the comment type — praise (receive + extend), **question** (answer specifically; reuse recurring ones as content — the strongest form is a native video reply to the comment), neutral (deepen with a question back), **criticism** (acknowledge → fix → take private), troll (don't feed), spam (delete). Nudge **member-to-member** conversation, not a wall of brand replies. See `references/replying-to-your-comments.md`. Comment on **ICP + niche thought-leader** posts to borrow their audience. **Add value** — an insight, a respectful disagree-and-explain, a concrete build (15+ words, in voice). **Never** "great post," veiled self-promo, or anything AI-obvious. See `references/strategic-commenting.md`.
